terms.name: Iʿrāb (grammatical analysis)
terms.def: Stating each word's function in the sentence, its case or mood, and the marker that shows it. Also: the case system itself.

terms.name: Declinable
terms.def: A word whose ending changes to show its grammatical role — most nouns and the present-tense verb.

terms.name: Built (indeclinable)
terms.def: A word whose ending never changes for role — pronouns, most particles, the past-tense verb, the imperative. Contrast مُعْرَب.

terms.name: Case marker
terms.def: The vowel or letter on a word's end that shows its case — e.g. a ḍamma for the nominative.

terms.name: Default marker
terms.def: The basic marker for a case: ḍamma (rafʿ), fatḥa (naṣb), kasra (jarr), sukūn (jazm).

terms.name: Secondary marker
terms.def: A marker that stands in for the default one — e.g. wāw/yāʾ/alif on the dual, sound plurals, and the five nouns; ن or its loss on the five verbs.

terms.name: Implied marker
terms.def: A case marker that is understood but not written, because the word's final letter can't carry it (مقصور, منقوص, a noun with -ī).

terms.name: Grammatical position
terms.def: The case slot a built word or a whole clause occupies even though it shows no marker — e.g. a pronoun 'in the position of rafʿ as subject'.

terms.name: Attachment point
terms.def: The verb or word that a prepositional or adverbial phrase hangs from in meaning.

terms.name: Quasi-sentence
terms.def: A preposition-plus-noun phrase or an adverbial — behaves as a unit, often as a khabar or a ḥāl.

terms.name: Nominative (state)
terms.def: The case of the subject/topic and of anything predicated of it. Default marker: ḍamma.

terms.name: Accusative (state)
terms.def: The case of the object and of several adverbial roles (ḥāl, tamyīz, …). Default marker: fatḥa.

terms.name: Genitive (state)
terms.def: The case after a preposition and of the second term of an iḍāfa. Default marker: kasra.

terms.name: Jussive (mood)
terms.def: A mood of the present-tense verb only — after لم, لا الناهية, and conditional particles. Default marker: sukūn.

terms.name: In the nominative
terms.def: Said of a specific word that is in the rafʿ case.

terms.name: In the accusative
terms.def: Said of a specific word that is in the naṣb case.

terms.name: In the genitive
terms.def: Said of a specific word that is in the jarr case.

terms.name: In the jussive
terms.def: Said of a present-tense verb that is in the jazm mood.

terms.name: Ḍamma marker
terms.def: The 'u' vowel, the default marker of the nominative.

terms.name: Fatḥa marker
terms.def: The 'a' vowel, the default marker of the accusative.

terms.name: Kasra marker
terms.def: The 'i' vowel, the default marker of the genitive.

terms.name: Sukūn marker
terms.def: The 'no vowel' sign, the default marker of the jussive.

terms.name: Nominal sentence
terms.def: A sentence that opens with a noun: a mubtadaʾ plus a khabar.

terms.name: Verbal sentence
terms.def: A sentence that opens with a verb: a fiʿl, its fāʿil, and any object.

terms.name: Topic (of a nominal sentence)
terms.def: The noun a nominal sentence starts with — always rafʿ.

terms.name: Comment / predicate
terms.def: What is said about the mubtadaʾ — a single word, a clause, or a quasi-sentence; rafʿ when a single word.

terms.name: Verb
terms.def: A word denoting an action or state bound to a time.

terms.name: Doer / subject of a verb
terms.def: Who or what performs the verb — always rafʿ, and it may follow the verb.

terms.name: Deputy subject
terms.def: The noun that takes the fāʿil's place, and its rafʿ, when the verb is passive (مجهول).

terms.name: Direct object
terms.def: Who or what the verb's action falls on — always naṣb.

terms.name: First term of a construct
terms.def: The possessed noun in an iḍāfa — drops its own الـ and tanwīn; its case comes from its role in the sentence.

terms.name: Second term of a construct
terms.def: The possessor noun in an iḍāfa — always jarr, and it carries the definiteness of the whole phrase.

terms.name: Preposition
terms.def: A particle (فِي، عَلَى، مِنْ، إِلَى، بِـ، لِـ …) that puts the following noun into the genitive.

terms.name: Preposition + its noun
terms.def: A preposition together with the genitive noun it governs — the pair acts as one unit (a shibh al-jumla).

terms.name: Adjective (qualifier)
terms.def: A word describing a noun and following it in case, definiteness, gender, and number.

terms.name: Operator (nāsikh)
terms.def: A word that enters a nominal sentence and changes its marking — كان and its sisters, إنّ and its sisters, ظنّ and its sisters.

terms.name: Noun of inna
terms.def: The former mubtadaʾ after إنّ or a sister — becomes naṣb.

terms.name: Predicate of inna
terms.def: The comment after إنّ or a sister — stays rafʿ.

terms.name: Noun of kāna
terms.def: The former mubtadaʾ after كان or a sister — stays rafʿ.

terms.name: Predicate of kāna
terms.def: The comment after كان or a sister — becomes naṣb.

terms.name: Clause with a case slot
terms.def: A subordinate clause that stands in for a single word (a khabar, a naʿt, a ḥāl, a mafʿūl bih) and so occupies that word's case.

terms.ar: جُمْلَة لَا مَحَلَّ لَهَا مِنَ الإِعْرَاب
terms.name: Clause with no case slot
terms.def: A clause that can't be replaced by a single word — the opening clause, a relative clause, a parenthetical — so it has no case.

terms.name: Relative clause
terms.def: The clause after الَّذِي / الَّتِي … that completes its meaning; it has no case slot and must contain a pronoun referring back.
